detail.longDescription: A secret in an env var is readable by every program running as you (/proc/<pid>/environ, ps -E). Your coding agent and its MCP servers run as you. Trellix (Oct 14) names command-line credentials among ten ways agents leak secrets doing ordinary work. That is why shell.online v0.24.1 moved the session password from an env var onto a pipe. Share a live terminal by browser link: https:// shell.online https:// cybersecuritynews.com/ai-agent s-4/ # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # Terminal
